questions: Did the party follow a treasure map to Brandonsford that also showed other locations they could not identify?
Does Brandonsford have two taverns, the busy Clumsy Fox Tavern and the quieter Golden Egg Tavern?
Does Brandonsford have a farm at the edge of town?
Did a frog Dr Uriah spoke with using magic warn that a mischievous Clurichen emerges from the river every night and enters town, and advise avoiding wherever it goes?
Did Dunk, preferring solitude, split from the party to scavenge at the farm at the edge of town?
Is Bentley the halfling owner of the Clumsy Fox Tavern who tends the bar?
Was a red-haired noblewoman named Lady Hilda among the patrons at the Clumsy Fox Tavern?
Did Dr Uriah notice that a greasy-haired thief in the Clumsy Fox Tavern wore a jar containing a live wasp around his neck?
Does Sir Phidipaldi own named weapons, a lance called Lady Isaboob and another called Sir Chumunga?
Did Lady Hilda say that a dragon was rumored to be near Brandonsford?
Did Lady Hilda direct Sir Phidipaldi to Eric the Reeve, who was hiring dragon slayers?
Did Lady Hilda offer to join the party for suitable pay?
Did Lady Hilda appear experienced, wearing chain mail and carrying a shield, seeming more seasoned than the party?
Did Bentley say that a shipment needed by the whole town was a week overdue and that the townsfolk could not afford to hire adventurers to retrieve it?
Did Farmer Gill recount that centuries ago Sir Brandon and his companions slew a dragon using a magical sword given to him by a fairy, after which the town was named for Brandon?
Did Farmer Gill suggest Dunk would make an excellent farmhand and offer to sell him a shabby mule named Seamus for one hundred gold so he could start his own farm?
Did Farmer Gill tell Dunk that the 'great work' available was killing the dragon?
Did Farmer Gill say he had already sent all three of his sons to kill the dragon, expecting them to return victorious?
Did Farmer Gill confirm that Sir Brandon's dragon was unquestionably killed centuries ago and assume the present black dragon must be a different one?
Did Dunk reveal that he was sent away from his village when he was young?
Did Eric the Reeve offer the party one thousand gold to kill the dragon and drag its corpse into Brandonsford?
Did Eric the Reeve say that a local woodsman named George encountered the small black dragon and lost an arm to it?
Did Sir Phidipaldi claim that black dragons do not exist and that Clurichen create illusory black dragons, trick people, and sometimes steal their limbs?
Did Dr Uriah recognize that Sir Phidipaldi's claims about black dragons and Clurichen were false?
Was Eric the Reeve offended by the suggestion that George had lied about the dragon?
Did the party follow a treasure map to Brandonsford, the only location on the map they recognized, believing the treasure might lie at one of its unidentified marked sites?
Did Eric the Reeve, insisting he had known George his whole life, demand to know how a Clurichen could have made George's severed arm disappear?
Did Sir Phidipaldi remove a glove and strike Eric the Reeve across the face with it?
Did Sir Phidipaldi declare that Eric had offended his honor and challenge him to a duel at dawn?
Did Eric the Reeve become flustered, believing Sir Phidipaldi to be the more experienced combatant, after being challenged to a duel?
Was the man Dr Uriah approached in the Clumsy Fox Tavern identified as a thief wearing a jar containing a wasp?
Did a man introduce himself as Drop Dead Ned in the Clumsy Fox Tavern?
Did Drop Dead Ned explain that the creature in his jar is a killer wasp used to kill targets quickly?
Did Drop Dead Ned offer his and the killer wasp's services for one hundred gold per week plus ten percent of any treasure?
Did Drop Dead Ned declare that he would do anything if allowed to kill people?
Did Drop Dead Ned say he prefers slow-acting poisons because he enjoys watching his victims die?
Did Drop Dead Ned revise his proposal to offer Dr Uriah five gold for each victim he is permitted to kill and cut up as he pleases, while keeping his weekly fee at one hundred gold?
Did Farmer Gill tell Dunk that nothing had entered Brandonsford for months, leaving Warwick's smithy with little ordinary stock?
Did Farmer Gill tell Dunk that Warwick possesses a magnificent mithril chain shirt that he refuses to sell?
Did Farmer Gill speculate to Dunk that Warwick's protective charms might be meant to ward off Ingrid the alchemist, who is attracted to him?
Did Bentley expel Sir Phidipaldi from the Clumsy Fox Tavern for the night, sending him to the Golden Egg Tavern, while allowing his companions to remain?
Did Sir Phidipaldi declare, while being ejected, that the Clumsy Fox Tavern had violated Zeus's law of courtesy and thereby invited its own doom?
Was the Golden Egg Tavern nearly empty, with no music, food, or patrons besides its owner Quinn?
Was Quinn's ale at the Golden Egg Tavern three times more expensive than the ale at the Clumsy Fox Tavern?
Was Quinn's ale at the Golden Egg Tavern watered down?
Did Quinn tell Sir Phidipaldi that every good ale shipment he receives is partly emptied or knocked over during the night?
Did Quinn blame Bentley for his theft, believing that the Clumsy Fox Tavern's popularity and Fox Tail brew depend on theft from the Golden Egg?
Did Sir Phidipaldi offer to help Quinn retaliate against Bentley?
Did Quinn offer Sir Phidipaldi one hundred gold to investigate the theft and propose staging a fake ale shipment in the Golden Egg's cellar to catch the culprit?
Did Sir Phidipaldi accept Quinn's plan to deliver bottles filled with water as a supposed ale shipment to catch the tavern thief?
Does Brandonsford lack standing guards, relying instead on able-bodied townsmen rotating through the night watch?
Did Waymon Tisdale say the party had come from Ithaca?
Is the frog Dr Uriah communicated with named Reginald?
Did Bentley offer Waymon a complimentary first mug of his Fox Tail brew and rooms for ten silver pieces per night?
Did Bentley say the dragon's presence had left the town feeling downhearted?
Did Lady Hilda remain gentle, patient, and unflappable despite Sir Phidipaldi's flirtation, and buy him a drink?
Did Eric the Reeve look visibly stressed, with purple rings beneath his eyes?
Did Farmer Gill say he recently saw the new dragon but that it ignored him?
Did Sir Phidipaldi tell Lady Hilda that the party was undertaking a chivalric quest for treasure?
Did Dr Uriah buy two Fox Tail brews and give one to the stranger before speaking with him?
Did Dr Uriah examine the killer-wasp jar closely without attempting to take it?
Did Farmer Gill describe Warwick's smithy as filled with rabbit's feet, dream catchers, horseshoes, clovers, and other protective charms?
